claude.performance_metric: ~$4bn debt discharged; Chapter 11 filed Sept 2015, plan confirmed Feb 13, 2017, emerged Mar 1, 2017 as Samson Resources II, LLC owned by second lien lenders
claude.rationale: The realized record documents a financially-driven Chapter 11 restructuring — a contested plan process (loss of exclusivity in 2016, competing creditor plan) and discharge of ~$4 billion of debt with equity transferred to former second lien lenders. No slice line describes disruption at the product/process interface (no acquired-product/operations incoherence), so p4 is coded 0; the going-concern oil-and-gas business "surviving intact." No slice line describes a fracture between operations and people/management/culture — the disputes were creditor/lender contests over the reorganization plan, not operations-versus-organization integration, so p5 is coded 0.

gemini.rationale: The provided slice documents a Chapter 11 bankruptcy and financial reorganization process, focusing on debt discharge and equity transfer. There is no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway) or fracture at the process/organization interface (p5_pathway) during the post-deal trajectory.

grok.performance_metric: ~$4bn debt discharged; emerged Ch.11 Mar 2017; equity to 2nd-lien lenders
grok.rationale: The slice documents only the post-August 2015 Chapter 11 trajectory, contested plan process, February 2017 confirmation, and March 2017 emergence with ~$4 billion debt discharged and equity transferred to Samson Resources II owned by former second-lien lenders. No realized disruption at the product/process interface is described. No realized fracture at the process/organization (operations vs people/management/culture) interface is described.
